svg.title: Self-tuning | error-gated blind spot
svg.desc: Predict the centre from surrounding taps; gate both replacement and adaptation.
svg.text: Predict the centre from surrounding taps; gate both replacement and adaptation.
Only accepted pixels update weights and scale; later passes reuse restored neighbours.
9% random replacements; r = 2; h = 0; α = .01; 3 passes
ΔPSNR +9.71 dB • 96 × 64 synthetic pixels • independent educational implementation, not the camera benchmark
